newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $115/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $115/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were $1.00-$2.00 per cwt lower than last week on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said. Trade active Wednesday morning, turning slow at noon.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 114.00 to mostly 115.00,few 113.50. (weighted average 114.88)
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 114.00 to mostly 115.00, few 113.50. ( weighted average 114.79 ).
Compared to last week, steers and heifers mostly 1.00 lower than last week on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand moderate to good, seller interest mixed at the various bids.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 70.50-72.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 71.00, few 72.00.
Wk To Date- 21,600 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 57,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 104,600
